notes.title: Development Update!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

Good news! We're closer to the release date! 
Bad news! The release date is getting pushed.

Progress!

The gamemode selection screen is close to completion and the new gamemodes are up next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38661324/aaed2b6958fb82b2cd73aa408728ec2b99ee7362.png

We've also nearly completed the Shell Well! 
Every shell you collect will be dumped into a deep hole that will unlock new gamemodes as it's filled!
There will also be a hermit crab in the well which you can change the shell of by unlocking achievements!

The whoopsie

We forgot to set some time aside for the beta testing and marketing period in our original release date estimate. If you'd like to participate in the Beta then let us know and sometime in February you can help us find and fix all the bugs!

We'll be sure to let you know when the new release date is set. It should still be in the first quarter of the year so keep your shell shuffling skills at the ready and try the Versus Demo if you haven't already!

Fair winds to you all!
 - The Captain
